# agentcast

> A library of reusable sub-agent personas for Claude Code, validated and scored: install one in a step, check any persona against what Claude Code reads, route a task to the right one, and trial an outside persona in an E2B microVM.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what agentcast does, every tool and how to call it, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): overview, quick start, the library and the rules
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who agentcast is, what it owns, its boundaries

## Skills

- [skills/persona-validate/SKILL.md](skills/persona-validate/SKILL.md): validate and score persona files before they ship
- [skills/persona-scaffold/SKILL.md](skills/persona-scaffold/SKILL.md): write a new persona that passes the validator and scores 7 or more
- [skills/persona-cast/SKILL.md](skills/persona-cast/SKILL.md): pick, trial, install and prove the right persona for a job

## MCP tools

- [mcp/server.mjs](mcp/server.mjs): `agentcast-mcp` with `persona_dispatch`, `persona_get`, `persona_validate` and `persona_score`

## The library

- [library/researcher.md](library/researcher.md): multi-source web and codebase research
- [library/code-reviewer.md](library/code-reviewer.md): correctness, security, TypeScript and architecture review
- [library/test-writer.md](library/test-writer.md): unit and integration test generation
- [library/security-reviewer.md](library/security-reviewer.md): injection, auth, CORS and secrets audit
- [library/architect.md](library/architect.md): trade-offs and system design
- [library/qa-tester.md](library/qa-tester.md): user-perspective end-to-end QA and bug reports

## Code

- [validator/validate.mjs](validator/validate.mjs): the checks, and `KNOWN_FIELDS`
- [eval/eval.mjs](eval/eval.mjs): the 10-point rubric
- [eval/golden.json](eval/golden.json): golden validator and routing cases
- [dispatch/dispatch.mjs](dispatch/dispatch.mjs): task to persona routing
- [lib/trial.mjs](lib/trial.mjs): what a persona can do, and its commands run in E2B

## Optional

- [identity/MEMORY.md](identity/MEMORY.md): what Claude Code reads in a sub-agent file, and the library
- [identity/LEARNINGS.md](identity/LEARNINGS.md): corrections that became rules
- [sandbox/persona-sandbox.md](sandbox/persona-sandbox.md): testing a persona in isolation
